statement: The system shall allow a prescriber to issue an electronic prescription for a patient.
acceptance_criteria: A prescriber can successfully create and submit an e-Rx for a patient through the system.

statement: The system shall perform real-time drug-drug interaction and allergy contraindication checking at the point of ordering.
acceptance_criteria: The system provides real-time feedback to the prescriber regarding any drug-drug interactions or allergies that may contraindicate the prescription.

statement: The system shall ensure that controlled-substance prescriptions are signed by an authorized prescriber using two-factor authentication.
acceptance_criteria: The system requires the prescriber to complete a two-factor authentication protocol before signing a controlled-substance prescription.

statement: The system shall transmit the signed controlled-substance prescription to a pharmacy without the digital signature.
acceptance_criteria: The system can transmit a controlled-substance prescription to a pharmacy in its electronic form, even if the digital signature is not present.

statement: The system shall generate an audit record for each action related to the issuance of a controlled-substance prescription.
acceptance_criteria: The system records and maintains an audit trail of all actions related to the issuance of a controlled-substance prescription, including the date, time, identity of the person taking the action, and the outcome of the event.

statement: The system shall ensure that the audit records are protected from unauthorized deletion and modifications.
acceptance_criteria: The system prevents modifications to the audit records and protects them from unauthorized deletion.

statement: The system shall retain all archived records electronically for at least two years from the date of their receipt or creation.
acceptance_criteria: The system maintains and retains all archived records electronically for a minimum period of two years from the date of their receipt or creation.

statement: The system shall allow the prescriber to cancel or change an existing electronic prescription.
acceptance_criteria: The prescriber can successfully cancel or modify an existing e-Rx through the system.

statement: The system shall ensure that the patient's demographic and observation data are recorded, including race, ethnicity, preferred language, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, name to use, pronouns, and date of birth.
acceptance_criteria: The system records and maintains the patient's demographic and observation data as required by the evidence.

statement: The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted to the pharmacy within 2 seconds for 95% of requests under a load of 50 concurrent prescribers.
acceptance_criteria: The system transmits controlled-substance prescriptions to the pharmacy within 2 seconds for 95% of requests under a load of 50 concurrent prescribers.

statement: The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted to the pharmacy without any alteration or truncation of data during transmission.
acceptance_criteria: The system ensures that the controlled-substance prescription data remains intact and unaltered during transmission from the prescriber to the pharmacy.

statement: The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted in its original electronic form and not converted to another form during transmission.
acceptance_criteria: The system transmits the controlled-substance prescription in its original electronic form without any conversion to another format during transmission.

statement: The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted only after an original prescription has not been printed.
acceptance_criteria: The system does not allow the transmission of a controlled-substance prescription if an original prescription was printed prior to attempted transmission.

statement: The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted only if it has been signed by an authorized prescriber.
acceptance_criteria: The system transmits a controlled-substance prescription only after it has been signed by an authorized prescriber.

statement: The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted to the designated pharmacy only.
acceptance_criteria: The system transmits the controlled-substance prescription only to the designated pharmacy.

statement: The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted in a format that can be read and processed by the pharmacy application.
acceptance_criteria: The system transmits the controlled-substance prescription in a format that is compatible with the pharmacy application.

statement: The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted in a secure manner to prevent unauthorized access.
acceptance_criteria: The system transmits the controlled-substance prescription using secure communication protocols to prevent unauthorized access.

statement: The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted in a manner that complies with all applicable regulations and standards.
acceptance_criteria: The system transmits the controlled-substance prescription in compliance with all applicable regulations and standards.
